_comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your devices. hide: exact device names to exclude. rename: map raw device names (as reported by the system) to display names. expect: devices that always get a row (grayed out when offline), using display names after rename is applied. order: row order, using display names, independent of expect. Falls back to expect's order when omitted. pushed_folder: overrides where pushed device JSON/txt files are read from, falls back to iCloud Drive when unset (null).
